text: SUPERVISOR — queue after WBSTEP5: SCULPTPICK-0606, a sculpt-kit UX ask from the user, verbatim: "on the sculpt mode when you click on a node on the 3d it should light up on the grid below exactly where its at before u even have to pull on it". Selection feedback: clicking a node on the 3D model immediately highlights the corresponding grid point below — before any drag. The 3D<->grid correspondence already exists (the sculpt wave landed grid nodes + per-point correspondence flags, commit f2ba9af16) — this wires CLICK-select to it: 3D node click -> the matching grid cell lights up (and stays lit while selected); ideally symmetric, grid-point click -> the 3D node glints too, since the correspondence is one mapping (one source of truth, both directions consume it). This lands in the SHARED sculpt kit (SCULPTKIT one-control-kit law) so characters, items, and every sculpt surface get it together — no per-surface special case. Visual proof via SELFSHOT (full path) showing a clicked 3D node + its lit grid cell. Verify green. DO NOT COMMIT. The user clicking a node and seeing the grid light up is the PASS.
